name: information-drawer
title: Information Drawer
description: Team profile grid with an animated information drawer and editable panel styling

props.name: duration
props.description: Drawer panel and overlay slide duration in seconds.

props.name: contentDuration
props.description: Duration in seconds of the content fade, staged after the panel opens and before it closes.

props.name: ease
props.description: GSAP easing used by the drawer panel and overlay.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the drawer animation starts, in seconds.

props.name: backgroundColor
props.description: Background color of the drawer panel.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text and icon color inside the drawer panel.

props.name: sidebarWidth
props.description: Desktop drawer width. Numbers are treated as viewport-width percentages.

props.name: overlayOpacity
props.description: Backdrop opacity while the drawer is open.
